title: Tumefaction
summary: TUMEFAC'TION, noun [Latin tumefacio, to make tumid. See Tumid.] The act or process of swelling or rising into a tumor; a tumor; a swelling.

inlines.v: TUMEFAC'TION, noun [Latin tumefacio, to make tumid. See Tumid.] The act or process of swelling or rising into a tumor; a tumor; a swelling.
